scope: Synthetic predecessor SELECT only; not production or full trigger/writer/RLS/concurrency validation.

source.originalQuery:
select *
      from audit_plan.rows
      where entity_table = $1 and entity_id is not distinct from $2
        and record_format in ('full_v2', 'diff_v2')
      order by event_sequence desc limit 1
source.candidateQuery:
select *
      from audit_plan.rows
      where entity_table = $1 and entity_id = $2
        and record_format in ('full_v2', 'diff_v2')
      order by event_sequence desc limit 1
source.nullQuery:
select *
      from audit_plan.rows
      where entity_table = $1 and entity_id is null
        and record_format in ('full_v2', 'diff_v2')
      order by event_sequence desc limit 1
source.indexDDL:
create index if not exists dashboard_audit_logs_v2_entity_sequence_idx
  on audit_plan.rows (entity_table, entity_id, event_sequence desc)
  include (id, action, audit_chain_id, chain_ordinal, after_hash)
  where record_format in ('full_v2', 'diff_v2');

results.label: DELETE requires and preserves compatible predecessor
DELETE without v2 history starts a migration boundary
INSERT starts a fresh chain despite a bad existing predecessor
NULL entity preserves the same continuity decision
NULL incoming before hash remains rejected
NULL predecessor after hash remains rejected
UPDATE preserves hash chain ordinal and predecessor
UPDATE without v2 history starts a migration boundary
deleted predecessor remains rejected even if hash matches
empty entity preserves the same continuity decision
latest DELETE cannot fall back to older live history
latest bad hash cannot fall back to older matching history
mismatching before hash remains rejected
missing chain ID remains rejected
missing chain ordinal remains rejected
zero ordinal retains existing increment and link rule
DESC preserves default NULLS FIRST
NULL entity is distinct from empty and literal null
NULL entity table still uses ordinary equality
NULL sequence tie retains unspecified identity
absent entity table returns no predecessor
empty entity is not NULL
finite sequence tie retains unspecified identity
missing entity returns no predecessor
only full_v2 and diff_v2 participate
other entity tables cannot win
sequence wins over identical or later changed_at
signed bigint ordering is preserved

design.distribution: 80% classes /20% other table; 10% full_v1 excluded; 1000 ID buckets, one NULL, one empty, 100 collapsed to hot; all changed_at equal; unique non-null event_sequence for v2. Heap has synthetic 256-character payload.
design.timing: Alternating original/candidate order per pair, sequential, warm cache; milliseconds are observations, not pass thresholds.
